recovery.method: Simulated one expired render lease on a disposable owned source; the deployed worker reclaimed it and published with a new storage lease. This did not restart the service.

metricsNote: Default Railway one-hour, 61-sample window includes startup and the preceding release; these are not isolated renderer peaks.

cleanup.note: Counts restricted to the four representative jobs, the deletion fixture and the interrupted-lease recovery fixture. Tombstones remain briefly to remove delayed uploads.
